property_summary: In any properly-instantiated cooler whose immutable args are (owner at 0x0, collateral at 0x14, debt at 0x28, factory at 0x3c), the public collateral() getter must return exactly the collateral token address stored at offset 0x14; the mutant reads offset 0x0 instead, so it returns the owner address and the equality fails whenever owner != collateral.
change_summary: Change the immutable-arg offset from 0x14 to 0x0 so collateral() returns the owner address instead of the collateral token address.
